column2: Your game is intact: it is saved at every action. Pick up where you were; if the problem comes back every time, return to the backup copy taken when this session began.

column2: The report contains the game version, your browser and the error; “with the game”, it adds your save code so the problem can be replayed. Nothing is sent: paste it into a message to report it.
column3: El informe contiene la versión del juego, tu navegador y el error; «con la partida», añade el código de tu partida guardada para reproducir el problema. No se envía nada: pégalo en un mensaje para informar.
